key_reasoning.reason: Touches cost-enricher.ts (session-window computation and the enrichCosts orchestration loop), usage-readers.ts (new withinWindow filter threaded through gatherUsageDeduped/gatherDedupedUsageRecords), and model-normalizer.ts (bare-Bedrock-id normalization) — all funneling through the single shared cost-enrichment pipeline that every agent plugin (claude, claude-desktop, codex family, gemini, kimi, pi, copilot-cli) relies on for billing. The windowEnd parameter change is read by multiple agent-specific dedup code paths (Claude and Pi explicitly), so this is a change that affects multiple agent workflows at once, not a single isolated component.

No exact precedent in the codebase for per-session-window, cross-session dedup filtering of billing-sensitive usage records (observedEnd-bounded candidate windows, cosmetic upper-bound reporting for open sessions sharing a file). The initial implementation needed a documented follow-up 'code-review fix-up' pass (3 files, 64 insertions / 23 deletions) to correct edge cases, which is direct evidence of real correctness risk in this area (financial/cost-accuracy data), even though no security or schema-migration surface is involved.
